promptHead: Athlete goal: 5K (Corrowmore Harvest 5K) on Sun Nov 15 2026, 6 weeks out, target run the whole way.

new.headline: Last week slipped by with no runs, so we pick up where you left off and nudge the run intervals from 2 minutes to 3. That keeps you honest to the race in six weeks without any catch-up.

new.analysis:
The reviewed week shows no runs on Mon, Wed or Sat, and nothing to replace them. Your body check and mood were good, so this is not an injury or illness story, and I am not going to treat it like one. Tell me in the next check-in what got in the way, so we plan around it.

Do not try to make up the missed runs. Adding a fourth day or a longer Saturday now is how new runners get hurt, and it would not buy you anything by Nov 15. Three steady weeks of running will.

The small step this week is interval length, not total time. You handled 8 x 2 minutes well before the cold, so 6 x 3 minutes is the same running time with longer continuous efforts, which is what the race asks for. Saturday stretches to 30 minutes with 4-minute run blocks to start pointing at the full 5K.

Keep the easy days easy: breathing should let you speak a short sentence. If a run block feels harder than that, cut it short and walk; the plan is a guide, not a test.
